# COMMERCE — project overview

```
Doc            : analysis/platform/PROJECT-OVERVIEW.md
Role           : the active profile in one page — what every stage, gate and consumer of THIS project builds against
Generated from : project.yaml + profiles/commerce.yaml, by `gov.py render`
Project id     : commerce
```

Retail & wholesale commerce SaaS for small and medium traders in Egypt and the Gulf: back-office (purchasing, inventory, sales, receivables/payables, accounting, tax & e-invoicing), point of sale and an integrated e-commerce storefront — one catalogue, one stock, one customer base — built on the erp-core given, activity-aware through six capability flags.
